summary: @onereach/si-a-button preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue button UI component but its preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes it against a 727KB shipped file named math_init.js. math_init.js is a `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying an obfuscator.io-style rotated string array (WV8StW rotator, hex-keyed constant table) and is not human-readable. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with _0xNNNN identifiers and proxy objects that hide control flow. Fetching an alternate JS runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at `npm install` time bypasses Node-based static inspection and gives the shipped payload arbitrary code execution on the installer's host, with no relationship to the advertised UI-component purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
